summary: The vote that will not end: The first act of {the body} is choosing its leader, the vote fails round after round, and no one is sworn in until it ends.
realLife: It took 15 ballots over four days in January 2023 to elect him Speaker. No new member could be sworn in until it ended, and the holdouts won rule changes, including letting one member force a vote to remove the Speaker.
gates: The first day of a new term of {the body}.
The leadership vote has failed at least once.

branches.then: One member can now force a vote to remove the leader, and {holdouts} get seats on the rules committee.
Abstaining helps elect the leader without your name on it.
